questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Inventions] Who is credited with inventing the first practical telephone?
A. Alexander Graham Bell
B. Thomas Edison
C. Nikola Tesla
Answer: A. Alexander Graham Bell is widely credited with inventing the first practical telephone in 1876.
questions.de: Wem wird die Erfindung des ersten praktisch brauchbaren Telefons zugeschrieben, das 1876 patentiert wurde?
questions.en: Who is credited with inventing the first practical telephone, patented in 1876?

timeline.labelEn: Alexander Graham Bell is granted US patent 174,465, the master telephone patent
timeline.labelDe: Alexander Graham Bell erhält das US-Patent 174.465, das grundlegende Telefonpatent

questions.notes: Priority is disputed (Antonio Meucci, Elisha Gray, Philipp Reis), but Bell holds the 1876 patent and is the standard credited answer.

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] Which moon of Saturn has a methane cycle?
A. Titan
B. Enceladus
C. Rhea
Answer: A. Titan has a methane cycle similar to Earth’s water cycle. It features methane clouds, methane rain, and even methane lakes and seas, making it a unique body in the solar system.
questions.de: Welcher Saturnmond hat einen Methankreislauf mit Methanwolken, -regen und -seen, ähnlich dem Wasserkreislauf der Erde?
questions.en: Which moon of Saturn has a methane cycle, with methane clouds, rain and lakes, much like Earth’s water cycle?

timeline.labelEn: Christiaan Huygens discovers Titan, Saturn’s largest moon
timeline.labelDe: Christiaan Huygens entdeckt Titan, den größten Saturnmond

questions.notes: Wikipedia: Titan’s methane cycle nearly resembles Earth’s water cycle; its lakes and seas hold liquid methane and ethane.
